player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({piece}). Opponent is ({opp}). Submit moves as '[b1 c3]' (from → to). All pieces move like chess knights.
Each capture scores {score_per_capture} point. Game ends after {max_moves} moves or when a player has no legal move / no pieces. Higher score wins.

invalid_move.not_your_piece: ငဝ်ႈငႃႇမၼ်းဢမ်ႇၸႂ်ႈ ၶိူင်ႈၶွင်သူ။
invalid_move.own_piece: ဢမ်ႇၸၢင်ႈလူင်းၼိူဝ်ၼႃႈလိၼ်ၸဝ်ႈၵဝ်ႇလႆႈ။
invalid_move.not_knight: ဢမ်ႇၸႂ်ႈ လွင်ႈတူင်ႉၼိုင် ၵူၼ်းႁတ်းငၢၼ်။

game_action.moved: ကစားသမား {player_id} သူ၏ အရာကို {frm} မှ {to} သို့ ရွှေ့ပြောင်းခဲ့သည်။
game_action.capture: {observation} ကို ဖမ်းယူနေပါသည်! (+{score_per_capture})

outcome.no_pieces: ၽူႈလဵၼ်ႈ {player_id} ဢမ်ႇမီးမၢၵ်ႇ။
outcome.cannot_move: ၽူႈလဵၼ်ႈ {player_id} ဢမ်ႇလႆႈၶၢႆႉ။
outcome.higher_score: လွင်ႈလႆႈဢဝ်ဢၼ်သုင်လိူဝ်ၼႆႉယဝ်ႉ။
